correctness.rationale: A direct degree and blank-vertex argument proves optimum weight at least six. At weight six a symmetric-parameter neighborhood calculation forces a color-one triple to be independent or an induced path and color-two triple to be its unique closed-antineighborhood; transitive coordinate symmetries and representative checks establish the involution. Exact triple counts give 320. Two separately constructed graph implementations exhaust every function of weight at most six and every pair of optima; both reproduce 1440 exact-two-copy trades, degree nine, connectedness, triangle-free property and common radius/diameter five with all-source BFS shell tuple (1,9,54,159,90,7). Scripts and their deterministic outputs are included.

value.rationale: The exact involution pairing independent and path triples is a natural geometric classification of all resource-optimal configurations of a classical strongly regular graph. The sharp frozen-at-one yet connected-at-two transition and uniform 320-state finite metric explain the operational reconfiguration cost of preserving full two-resource coverage, not just a known lower bound or a routine isolated parameter.
